hypothesis: Providing the model with strictly past-only video and author historical click (valid play) and like rates as numerical features will inject granular item-engagement priors that differentiate between clickbait and high-preference items, raising primary.
rationale: The knowledge file states that multi-task learning often fails here due to the nested nature of labels and sparsity of likes, but that auxiliary behaviors (clicks, likes) contain genuinely different signals. Explicitly aggregating them as past-only numerical features gives the model access to these multi-behavior signals safely. This satisfies the strategy of adding new information (auxiliary behaviors) while staying within a proven tabular architecture.

harness_extra.gain_evidence: Previous runs achieved +0.0005 by injecting past-only long_view rate. Click is a less strict threshold (nested threshold variable) and Like is a sparse but explicit positive behavior. Adding their historical rates provides the BPR model with dense, multi-objective item-quality signals without the negative transfer risks of multi-head training.
harness_extra.ablation_plan: champion_equiv: zeroes out the new click and like rate columns (indices 2, 3, 6, 7) in Xnum, scoring the exact prior 5-feature baseline.
